modern: The nature of what is universally useful has been compelled to do this.
original: The nature of that which is [universally] useful has been compelled to do this.

explained.summary: This is a brief, cryptic note. Marcus seems to be telling himself that whatever has just happened was necessary, because the way the universe works serves the good of the whole and had to bring it about. What looks like misfortune to you is part of what keeps everything running.
